files.content:
export { StreamingIndicator } from './StreamingIndicator';
export type { StreamingIndicatorProps } from './StreamingIndicator';

{
  "id": "streaming-indicator",
  "name": "StreamingIndicator",
  "tier": "atom",
  "description": "Shows that an AI response is currently streaming.",
  "designIntent": "Give users immediate feedback while generated content is arriving.",
  "props": [
    {
      "name": "isStreaming",
      "type": "boolean",
      "required": true,
      "description": "Whether the indicator is visible."
    },
    {
      "name": "text",
      "type": "string",
      "defaultValue": "Generating…",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Status text."
    },
    {
      "name": "size",
      "type": "'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'",
      "defaultValue": "md",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Dot and label scale.",
      "enum": [
        "sm",
        "md",
        "lg"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "tone",
      "type": "'primary' | 'muted' | 'current'",
      "defaultValue": "primary",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Dot colour: brand primary, muted foreground, or the inherited text colour.",
      "enum": [
        "primary",
        "muted",
        "current"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "dotCount",
      "type": "number",
      "defaultValue": "3",
      "required": false,
      "description": "How many dots pulse."
    },
    {
      "name": "showLabel",
      "type": "boolean",
      "defaultValue": "true",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Render the label beside the dots; the text stays the accessible name either way."
    }
  ],
  "examples": [
    {
      "title": "Generating state",
      "code": "<StreamingIndicator isStreaming={true} />"
    }
  ],
  "accessibility": [
    {
      "feature": "Status text",
      "implementation": "The state includes human-readable text in addition to animation."
    }
  ],
  "package": "@slipstream-ui/ai",
  "importPath": "@slipstream-ui/ai",
  "version": "0.8.0",
  "sourceDir": "streaming",
  "exportName": "StreamingIndicator"
}
